text: 你登上独木舟，顺流而下。下一处休息地点鱼兽丰足，一顿饱餐令你们恢复不少。终于，你们来到查理·狐尾所说的那段险恶河道——“分流之地”。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 242
text: You climb aboard the canoe and set out downriver. At your next rest spot, fish and game abound. A good meal does wonders to restore you. At last, you come to the treacherous segment of the river that Charlie Foxtail called “the place of splitting water.”
